blocks.text: Kidney transplant ek surgery (operation) hai jis mein kisi shakhs ke kaam na karne wale gurde ki jagah donor (gurda dene wale) ka sehatmand gurda laga diya jata hai. Yeh ilaj un logon ko diya jata hai jin ke gurde aakhri darje tak (end-stage) nakara ho chuke hon. Recipient (gurda lene wale) aur donor dono ke liye behtareen nataij ke liye transplant mein ehtiyat se jaanch (evaluation), milan (matching) aur nigrani (monitoring) zaroori hai.
Kidney transplant ke liye mumkina donors
Related donor (rishtedar donor): jo shakhs recipient ka khooni (genetic) rishtedar ho, jaise maan baap, bhai behan ya aulad, woh gurde ka sab se behtar donor ho sakta hai.

Unrelated donor (ghair rishtedar donor): yeh donor recipient ka khooni rishtedar nahin hota, jaise shauhar ya biwi, dost ya saath kaam karne wala. Is qisam ka atiya kam aam hai, lekin agar donor aur recipient ka blood group aur tissue type mil jaye to yeh bhi kamyab ho sakta hai.

Deceased donor (faut shuda donor): bohat se log hospitals mein register karwate hain ke maut ke baad un ke organs atiya kar diye jayen. Un ke organs, gurdon samet, un logon ko diye ja sakte hain jinhen transplant ki zaroorat ho. Faut shuda donor ke gurde recipient se blood group, tissue type aur immune system ki mutabiqat (compatibility) ki buniyad par ehtiyat se milaye jate hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Gurde ka atiya aakhri darje ki gurde ki bimari wale shakhs ke liye zindagi bachane wala tohfa ho sakta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq gurda dene se donor ki sehat ko lambe arse ka koi khaas khatra nahin, aur tehqeeq (studies) se pata chala hai ke aam taur par donors ki sehat ya umar par koi bura asar nahin parta.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq Pakistan ka pehla kidney transplant centre 1985 mein Karachi ke Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) mein qaim hua; yeh duniya ke sab se bare aur kamyab transplant centres mein se ek hai. Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute & Research Center (PKLI&RC) 2017 mein qaim hua. Yeh Lahore mein ek tertiary-care (sab se aala darje ka) hospital hai, jo gurde aur jigar ki bimariyon ke bare qaumi masle se nimatne ke liye bana, aur ilaj, transplant aur tehqeeq ka khaas markaz hai.
Kidney transplant ke saath kuch mumkina pecheedgiyan (complications) aur khatre hain. Maslan:

items: Recipient ka immune system naye gurde ko bahar ki (foreign) cheez samajh kar us par hamla kar sakta hai, jis se organ rejection (gurda radd hona) hota hai. Yeh tab bhi ho sakta hai jab mareez rejection rokne ke liye immunosuppressant dawaen (immune system ko dabane wali dawaen) le raha ho.
Jin mareezon ka immune system dabaya gaya ho unhen transplant ke baad infections ka khatra zyada hota hai.

Recipients ko organ rejection rokne ke liye immunosuppressant dawaen di jati hain. In dawaon ke side effects ho sakte hain, jaise high blood pressure, wazan barhna, aur infections aur cancers ka zyada khatra.

blocks.prompt: Kidney transplant ke mareezon ko immunosuppressant dawayein kyun di jati hain, aur is ki qeemat kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke immune system diye gaye gurde ko ajnabi samajh kar radd na kare. Qeemat kamzor difa hai: zyada infections aur cancers, aur high blood pressure aur wazan barhne jaise side effects.

items: Kidney transplant: end-stage kidney failure mein nakara gurde ki jagah donor ka sehatmand gurda.
Donors: related (khooni rishtedar, sab se behtar), unrelated (blood group aur tissue type milen to), deceased (maut ke baad atiya).
Masail: organ rejection, infections, immunosuppressant dawaon ke side effects.
